chat.request: Power package for a hospital wing, N+1, 480 V service, 65 kA: 200 kW imaging and IT, 50 kW egress lighting and fire alarm at 208 V, 150 kW HVAC. — Marcus
chat.question: One question: is the HVAC optional standby, or does code require it on standby? It decides which transfer switch it sits on.

standards_text: Every size checked against the loads after redundancy, with the rule and rating behind every line. The equipment makers’ ratings certify the parts; the quote proves the package fits them.
standards: Emergency, critical and optional on separate transfer switches
UL 1008 switches sized to each class: 100, 400, 225 A
Generators 455 kW for 416 kW of load
refusal: Life-safety loads with no generator? Refused: 60 kW needed, none there. Generator priced.
